patches.decision_note: This is delivery and formatting of a non-executable resume document, not a software behavior, system configuration, data-state rule, interface, or executable artifact.
ATS optimization is a formatting quality of the resume-writing deliverable; this project does not implement or maintain the applicant-tracking software or another executable system.
The Canva layout and branding concern visual design of a standalone resume document rather than software UI behavior or another implementation-relevant artifact.
This item records delivery of a non-executable cover-letter document and therefore falls outside implementation-relevant software Requirement state.
The visual design of a standalone cover letter is a professional-writing deliverable, not software UI, configuration, runtime behavior, or an executable artifact.
Consistency between two editions of non-executable application documents does not affect a future coding or system-maintenance decision.
Occupational positioning within a resume and cover letter is career-writing content rather than software behavior, system-enforced logic, or product copy rendered by software.
Employment dates and education details are facts in a standalone resume-writing deliverable, not implementation-relevant application data or system state.
Writing and revising a persuasive resume narrative is a professional-writing service rather than implementation of software behavior or an executable artifact.
Tailoring the voice and narrative of a standalone cover letter is non-software content work and does not satisfy the implementation-relevance boundary.
The included revision round is a service-package and document-editing obligation; it does not change code, configuration, interfaces, infrastructure, system behavior, or an executable artifact.
